note: NEW FAMILY (v0.6.0, hand-authored spec fixture — Rust-native, no Flask recording exists; DECISIONS.md 2026-08-24). schema_version dispatch is a match: 1 -> the v1 parser, anything else -> 400 naming the received and supported versions. Message text is NOT graded — grade status + {error} shape. The versioning policy (docs/EXPORT-FORMAT.md): importers accept every schema_version <= their current one, so v1 files import forever; only files from a NEWER schema than the server knows are rejected. Unknown extra JSON keys inside a supported version are ignored (future additive fields import fine) — version bumps are reserved for breaking changes. Nothing is imported.
